## Verified Production Repositories & Systems
- [ResultSniper-BD](https://github.com/shahriyarsojibhasan/resultsniper-bd): Bangladesh Education Board analytics, automated marksheet parsing, and stateless HMAC-SHA256 QR verification.
- [WiFi-Charger-Controller](https://github.com/shahriyarsojibhasan/wifi-charger-controller): Smart 12V lead-acid/lithium charger controller combining NodeMCU ESP8266 firmware, EEPROM persistence, Firebase RTDB, and a cross-platform Flutter dashboard APK.
- [DuoVista-PDF-Viewer](https://github.com/shahriyarsojibhasan/duovista-pdf-viewer): Dual-pane split PDF study workstation and IELTS exam companion packaged as a Chrome MV3 extension and PWA.
- [FRB-Release-APK](https://github.com/shahriyarsojibhasan/frb-release-apk): Official signed Android application releases for the FRB Infinity course platform.
- [Shahriyar-Live-TV](https://github.com/shahriyarsojibhasan/shahriyar-live-tv): Open-source Bangladeshi IPTV aggregator and Cloudflare Workers edge player.
- [Shahriyar-Tools](https://github.com/shahriyarsojibhasan/shahriyar-tools): Web-based client-side utility studio featuring ReUnion Poster Studio and Baki Passbook Studio.
